subject: Software Engineering
moduleDescription: Rigorous study of O(n log n) and sub-linear sorting algorithms: Shell Sort gap-sequence mathematics, Merge Sort stable divide-and-conquer and external sorting, Quick Sort Lomuto/Hoare partition schemas and randomised pivot strategies, Heap Sort BuildHeap O(n) proof and in-place extraction, the Omega(n log n) information-theoretic lower bound, and linear-time non-comparison sorts (Counting Sort and Radix Sort LSD/MSD).
